results.name: Two isolated workspaces have live data, popup, vault grant, approved file and download
Native removal revokes access and pending reads while preserving unrelated live work
Restart purges only the tombstoned profile and cannot recreate its grant
results.error: Removed synthetic profile remained after restart.

diagnosis: Chromium can load the last-used workspace as the initial profile before CEF OnContextInitialized. CEF adopts that already-loaded profile as its global context, overriding its populated cache path. The synthetic root selected its tombstoned workspace and reopened multiple database logs during restart. Cleanup safely refused a sharing violation during preflight; no entries were deleted.
fix: Pin the browser-process initial profile to Default before Chromium profile creation. Preserve the existing cleanup deletion policy.
regression: Seed the removed workspace in synthetic Local State profile.last_used and profile.last_active_profiles while the owned browser is stopped, then require the tombstoned profile to be absent after restart.
scope: Generated synthetic profile only. No real profile contents, credential values or absolute local paths are included. This record does not claim human removal confirmation or a passing fixed build.
